context: A boss reviews an event-cancellation impact
purpose: Teach: キャンセル/器具/儲かる/スクリプト/ゲート/実例/使い勝手/成り立た

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 今回のキャンセル、収支は儲かる方向に戻せるか?
lines.en: With this cancellation, can we bring the numbers back into the black?
lines.style: Lean forward slightly. Clipped pace, each word precise. No flourish. Businesslike but not cold—the question of someone checking feasibility, not doubting.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。器具の使い勝手を改善した実例、社内で共有しています。
lines.en: Yes. We've been sharing case studies on equipment usability improvements internally.
lines.style: Even keel. Measured cadence. Hands steady. Confidence without overstatement—the report of someone who has done the legwork and knows what he's talking about.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: ゲートでの動線、スクリプトに従って整理を。
lines.en: The flow at gate traffic—organize it according to the script.
lines.style: Instructional but not harsh. Slight pause after the dash. Direct eye contact. The clarity of someone who expects competence and sees no need to soften the directive.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。計画が成り立たない部分は、別案も用意します。
lines.en: Understood. I'll have backup options ready for any parts where the plan doesn't hold.
lines.style: Quick nod of assent. Slightly faster tempo than before—eagerness to move forward. Calm certainty underneath. No apology, just readiness.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.style: Soft drop in volume. A beat of quiet weight. Not gratuitous—the full stop of someone whose few words carry actual trust.
